text_block_list.text:
She loves logic and theory.
And yet—our encounter felt entirely instinctual.
One day, while passing behind the school building—

Something fell from the sky.
It caught the rays of the setting sun, flashing with a bright glint—
You down there! Apologies, are you hurt?!

A cool, clear voice echoed from above. Looking up,
I saw a horsegirl leaning out of a classroom window.

Yes! My sincerest apologies.
I was lost in deep thought and suddenly—
choice_data_list: I'll bring them up to you!

text_block_list.text: ...Are you sure? You have my sincere thanks!

And so, I went to return the picked-up glasses
to the waiting horsegirl in the classroom—Biwa Hayahide.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Mm... The hinges move smoothly, and there are no
visible scratches on the lenses.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
These glasses are specially made to be worn even during races.
Naturally, they are built to withstand a fair amount of impact.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, if it were merely a drop from the second floor,
they theoretically should not sustain any damage—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
However, they could easily have been trampled by a horsegirl
running below. You are the one who reduced that probability to zero.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You have my gratitude. ...Thanks to you, tomorrow's plans
will proceed completely without impediment.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. —Judging by the badge on your lapel, you are a Trainer, yes?
If so, you must already be aware.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Tomorrow is the Selection Race... The day horsegirls aspiring
to debut prove their capabilities to Trainers in hopes of being scouted.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
And on tomorrow's Race 10 roster,
you will find my name... Biwa Hayahide.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: There is something I must accomplish on the Twinkle turf.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Naturally, I intend to seize it... the chance to make my debut, that is.

Her calm, measured tone brimmed with unyielding determination.
As I gazed into the quiet fire burning behind her lenses, she continued.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Let us make a declaration, shall we?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
In tomorrow's race, I will run near the front until the final corner.
By then, the leading pack will be bunched together in a tight cluster.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: As we clear the final turn, I will break away from the outside—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: And take first place by a margin of more than ten lengths.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
This is the theoretical outcome I have calculated.
As for what actually happens... come verify it tomorrow with your own eyes.

Biwa Hayahide's cool yet passionate "theories."
What kind of result would they ultimately yield...?

Intrigued, I went to watch the Selection Race the following day.
And there, she—

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
A fierce battle for the lead right from the gate!
The spotlight contender, Biwa Hayahide, settles into a prime pace-setting position!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Everything is proceeding precisely as predicted.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
The lead pack sweeps into the curve of the third corner!
It's a fierce, neck-and-neck contest at the front!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: —Now, let us proceed!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
They round the fourth corner and hit the homestretch! Here comes Biwa Hayahide on the outside!
Biwa Hayahide takes the lead! She's two, three lengths ahead already!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide crosses the finish liiiiiine in first!
A crushing victory by a massive margin!!!

Just as she had declared the day before, Biwa Hayahide put on
a showcase of absolute, flawless perfection...!

text_block_list.name: Mid-Career Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Man, that was incredible, Biwa Hayahide!
That effortless poise was practically preordained—

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer
text_block_list.text: Wait, huh...? H-Hey! Isn't that girl over there...?!

Biwa Hayahide had demonstrated terrifying ability.
You would think she'd be surrounded by scouts, but...
......Good work out there.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Oh, Brian. You came to watch?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Just passing through.

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I knew it! The "Monster," Narita Brian...!
I heard she was impossible to pin down, but to run into her here!

text_block_list.name: Mid-Career Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, this is our chance to scout her...!
Brian! Please, hear me out—!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Tch, what a pain...
See ya, Sis.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
No, wait, Brian.
Have you... lost too much weight?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
What is your nutritional management like?
Are you not getting enough sustenance?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Shut up. I eat plenty.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I see. You must dislike the new cafeteria menu
they introduced recently, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You have always been far too picky with food.
Listen closely: our rate of energy consumption is—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Aaargh! Why are you always so big-headed about everything?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
What did you say?! M-My head is not big!
It is completely standard size... Brian!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Good grief... She is utterly incorrigible.

text_block_list.name: Mid-Career Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Ah, wait up, Brian!
With your talent, the Triple Crown is guaranteed! Please team up with—!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...My theoretical models clearly still have room for refinement.

A horsegirl who runs based on rigorous logic and calculation,
whose younger sister is hailed as a "Monster"—Biwa Hayahide.

I wanted to know more about her.
From the bottom of my heart, I truly did.
